description: This file contains functions for generating and seeding telemetry demo data for assets such as excavators and trucks. It defines utility functions for creating synthetic sensor readings, managing asset creation, and inserting telemetry records into a storage backend. The code appears to be part of a seed or test data setup for the telemetry backend system.
